'''Greg Tuck''' was a Decipher-era [[Squadron Members|Squadron Member]], listed as Red 56 from Flower Mound, Tx. The fan site's Squadron Members table marks the slot Retired after Decipher's SWCCG run.<ref name="sm-fan" />

He played from early 1996.<ref name="decsq-prof" />
